review_evidence: CarryAndCrossedProduct.lean: Contains Suslin elementary generation theorems, polynomial localization maps, matrix special linear group constructions, relative root/Z subgroups, hard commutator lemmas, and powered partition of unity — all marked as cross-module support for infinite Connes rigidity

FactorAndRigidity.lean: Defines ExponentFourExtension structure, two-torsion quotients, finite orbit subgroups, intrinsic subquotients, group cardinal invariants, semidirect canonical subgroups, and proves closure equalities for Cornulier's opposite roots

GroupConstruction.lean: Formalizes affine Hilbert actions, Cornulier's corelative property FH, affine generator word lengths, marked affine orbit points, ultralimit constructions, Gromov centered cocycles, and normalized minimizing sequences

SpectralAndPropertyT.lean: Develops crossed operator blocks, von Neumann closure equalities for character generators, carry/split character coefficients, projection-valued spectral measures, quotient fixed submodules, and spectral detection criteria for property (T)
summary: All four files in LeanPool/InfiniteConnesRigidity contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, lemmas, structures, and proofs related to operator algebras, group theory, crossed products, property (T), spectral theory, and the infinite Connes rigidity construction. None are pure import aggregators (each contains hundreds of private/public declarations with docstrings), none are duplicates, and all are part of a coherent formalization project. The previous review (RRV-196b034d6309-r2) sampled CarryAndCrossedProduct.lean (8447 lines at the time) and confirmed it carries genuine formal mathematics. Since then these four files have been added/changed and they similarly contain core mathematical content.
